title: Signs You Stopped Growing Remake
summary: Debunks height growth myths and introduces physical indicators of growth plate closure, pitching TallPlan.
style: 2D clean anime-inspired cel-shaded vector animation, solid outlines, bold flat colors, mint green glow accents, plain light background.
character: Teenage boy, 16 years old, short messy dark hair, athletic build, shirtless wearing black athletic shorts.
character_prompt: Full-body side profile of an athletic 16-year-old boy, short black messy hair, shirtless, black gym shorts, barefoot on plain white background. 2D modern clean anime cel-shaded style, bold outlines, neutral expression, no text.

keyframes.name: jawline_check
keyframes.prompt: Close-up front portrait of a teenage boy smiling confidently, defined square jawline outlined with a subtle mint green glowing edge, 2D anime cel-shaded style, solid outlines, clean plain background, no text.

keyframes.name: height_check
keyframes.prompt: Full body shot of a teenage boy standing upright on flat feet beside a wall, comparing his stature against a taller shadow silhouette, mint green aura pulsing around him, 2D clean anime style, no text.

base.shots: 0-3s: Close-up on the character's torso showing faint abdominal hair, camera pans up as a mint green cross-out flash shatters across screen. 3-6s: Medium shot of character standing against a wall looking puzzled as three mint green numeric circles (1, 2, 3) spin around him. 6-10s: Close-up zoom on character's jawline tracing a sharp square chin highlighted with mint green light. SFX: Whoosh, digital shatter, chime. Music: Upbeat energetic synth-pop groove.
base.vo: Think body hair means you stopped growing? Totally false. Here are real signs your growth plates might be closing, starting with a developed square jawline.

ext.shots: 0-3s: Anatomical silhouette of male torso highlighting hormone glands glowing mint green. 3-5s: Medium full-body shot of character standing flat-footed, looking up at a taller shadow figure. 5-8s: Character points upward happily as an illuminated lightbulb appears above his head, bathed in mint green glow. SFX: Subtle hum, soft ding. Music: Energetic beat fades smoothly.
ext.vo: When hormone spikes settle, height gains slow down. Discover your actual remaining growth potential in TallPlan.

voice: Male, mid-20s, American accent, energetic and confident educational delivery, bright clear tone, ~160 WPM, crisp studio condenser mic.
music: Driving modern electronic beat with light synth pulses and punchy rhythm, upbeat and factual.

qa_checks.character: Maintains identical 16-year-old dark-haired male character design throughout all shots.
qa_checks.no_text: Zero on-screen text, numbers, or App Store graphics in generated footage.
qa_checks.pose: Standard standing postures, upright flat-foot contact, natural hand gestures.
qa_checks.anatomy: Anatomy shots focus cleanly on torso and jawline without skull or distorted facial transitions.
qa_checks.voice: Voiceover is clear, upbeat, strictly meets word count limits, and ends exactly with 'in TallPlan.'
